paper.title_en: Λ(1670) production in the <math altimg="si2.svg"><mrow><mi>ψ</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>3686</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>→</mo><mstyle mathvariant="normal"><mi>Λ</mi></mstyle><mover accent="true"><mstyle mathvariant="normal"><mi>Λ</mi></mstyle><mo>¯</mo></mover><mi>η</mi></mrow></math> reaction
paper.abstract_en: We perform a calculation of the invariant mass distributions in the <math altimg="si2.svg"><mrow><mi>ψ</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>3686</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>→</mo><mstyle mathvariant="normal"><mi>Λ</mi></mstyle><mover accent="true"><mstyle mathvariant="normal"><mi>Λ</mi></mstyle><mo>¯</mo></mover><mi>η</mi></mrow></math> reaction, where a neat peak for the excitation of the Λ(1670) and <math altimg="si4.svg"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mstyle mathvariant="normal"><mi>Λ</mi></mstyle><mo>¯</mo></mover><mrow><mo>(</mo><mn>1670</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></math> in the ηΛ and <math altimg="si5.svg"><mrow><mi>η</mi><mover accent="true"><mstyle mathvariant="normal"><mi>Λ</mi></mstyle><mo>¯</mo></mover></mrow></math> mass distributions, respectively, is observed. Our approach uses the fact that the ψ(3686), a <math altimg="si6.svg"><mrow><mi>c</mi><mover accent="true"><mi>c</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover></mrow></math> state, is a singlet of SU(3) in the u, d, s quarks and constructs the two flavor structures allowed with a pseudoscalar meson, a baryon and an antibaryon. The resonance peaks come from the final state interaction of meson baryon pairs, which generate the Λ(1670) in our approach. With a reasonable relative weight of the two flavor structures, the only free parameter of the theory, we are able to get the three mass distributions in good agreement with experiment, giving extra support to the molecular structure of the Λ(1670) resonance. The agreement with data improves with an extra resonant contribution with mass around 2200 MeV, possibly accounting for some resonances.
